request.query: A projection of polynomial coefficient support preserves upper bounds for coordinate exponents; supremum on image support is bounded by original supremum.

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.sup_support_pow_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_1 : OrderBot B] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid B] [AddLeftMono B] [AddRightMono B] {degb : A → B},
  degb 0 ≤ 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degb (a + b) ≤ degb a + degb b) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), (f ^ n).support.sup degb ≤ n • f.support.sup degb

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_eq_sup
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf n f = f.support.sup fun m => m n
